calculation.description: Cross-sectional short-term reversal, amplified when recent volatility is below its longer-term baseline; signal is lagged by one completed session to avoid look-ahead. Higher values indicate a recent loser with volatility contraction and expected rebound.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC in 2020-2022 (0.023969), 2023-2025 (0.017673), 2026-2027 (0.013200), and weaker but positive 2028-2030 (0.005192). Small 15-instrument cross-section warrants conservative interpretation.
